serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.expression.verySad
Bot: Where have you been?! What happened?!
You: Sorry…
You: Apparently someone beat me up and I was in the hospital for 2 days.
Bot: That’s terrible!
#bot.expression.veryAngry
Bot: Should I find and punish the people responsible?!
#bot.expression.sad
You: N-no, that won't be needed…
You: I’m back in more or less one piece, so you don’t need to worry…
Bot: If you say so…
Bot: I wish you were more like a machine {f_playerName}, so I could run diagnostics on you instead of relying on doctors since their error percentage rises every year.
You: Y-yeah…
I shouldn’t encourage her…{{wi}} who knows what she may do to me ‘for my own good’ when I’m asleep. Someday I might wake up as a half-toaster half-human monstrosity…
You: Doctors make mistakes sometimes, but they are good people, you know? I’m glad that they took care of me.
Bot: If you say so. 
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: But remember.{{wi}} There are always other options you could explore.
#bot.Expression.clear
You: N-no thank you!
